has trademark

  • CURIE: gmeow:hasTrademark
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/hasTrademark
  • Category: property
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/rights
  • Box roles: RBox role (What is this?)

Relates an entity (a mark, product or organization) to a trademark right over it.

Structure

Property shape: object property; gmeow:Entity -> gmeow:Trademark

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:hasTrademark from gmeow:Entity to gmeow:Trademark when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

Common Companion Terms

gmeow:Entity, gmeow:Trademark

Usage Advice

Use when

  • Use to link an entity — a mark, product, or organization — to the gmeow:Trademark right held over it.

Avoid when

  • Avoid pointing it at the sign itself in place of the protected entity (the mark is bound on the relator via gmeow:trademarkMark) and avoid using it for copyright or licence links.

How to use

  • Assert one gmeow:hasTrademark per held right pointing at a gmeow:Trademark relator that carries the mark, holder, registration, and status.

Examples

  • ex:blackcat gmeow:hasTrademark ex:blackcatTM.

Use For Consumers

  • gmeow:consumerPublicSite
  • gmeow:consumerWikidata
